what: Every run of the adjacency checks, failures included, with cause and fix. Bounds file unchanged since 5d0dfb1.

runs.failure: width ratio 1.695 for 4x diffusivity (bound [1.7, 2.3]) at 4 and 8 pixel diffusion lengths
runs.diagnosis: Width by resolution (pixels, k = 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8): 1.423, 2.206, 3.739, 6.897, 13.228. Successive ratios 1.550, 1.695, 1.845, 1.918 converge to 2; differences double, so width = a k + c with c about 0.6 pixel from the discrete edge. The model scales as sqrt(D); the test sampled an under-resolved scale.
runs.fix: Method: compare 8 and 16 pixel lengths (k 2 and 4). Bound unchanged.

runs.check: GPU parity, SwiftShader, first run (presets at 150 and 100 um, chemistry at full resolution)
runs.result: 4 of 4 pass: max 1, p99.9 0, mean under 3e-5 codes

runs.check: look review of the CPU sheets
runs.result: edge effect barely visible at 640 px with 150 um lengths
runs.change: Presets moved to 0.3 to 0.8 mm (Eberhard effect reported within about 1 mm). Chemistry grid coarsened automatically so the longer length spans about 2.5 cells (steps about 34 at any size). Node tests pinned to scale 1, which they had implicitly. Bounds unchanged.

runs.check: node tests after the preset change
GPU parity, SwiftShader, final presets (chemistry scale 2 to 4 at 320 px)
runs.result: 4 of 4 pass: max 1, p99.9 0, mean under 3e-5 codes
